source_snapshot.procedure: 【Before Test】 verify configuration and clear logs. 【During Test】 issue raw 0x06 0x37 in-band and OOB, record the response and compare after firmware update. 【After Test】 collect evidence and inspect logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command should be sent without any error.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Claims no single runnable command despite raw 0x06 0x37 being specified; requests exact expected output.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL correctly notes the missing expected decode but overlooks that the raw read is explicit.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE / CHANGED with 16-byte GUID parsing, canonical byte order and same-target baseline provenance.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 1010/2291 keeps PARTIAL and exposes the command-success-only criterion.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: The OOB variant is useful for correlation but is transport-distinct; firmware update cases carry update coverage.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 treats schema/baseline as readiness input; ED-35 preserves read-only scope; ED-38 prohibits automatic retry and unsafe credentials.

original_test_intent: Read the BMC System GUID through the in-band path and compare the canonical identity with an approved same-target baseline, including an optional post-firmware-update observation.
original_method: Run preserved raw 0x06 0x37 in-band, decode its response with the approved byte order and compare to a versioned baseline; OOB is optional correlation and firmware update remains separate.
manual_activity: Engineer approves the GUID response layout and baseline provenance once; no per-run confirmation is required for the bounded read.
required_inputs: Same-target pre/post baseline and firmware provenance
safety_requirements: Do not perform firmware update, reset, power or configuration actions.
Fail closed on wrong length, invalid GUID or unresolved byte order.
agent_execution_scope: Verify host/BMC identity and in-band availability.
Validate completion and exactly decode the GUID.
Compare only with an approved same-target baseline.
Return evidence without claiming firmware-update or DUT PASS.
engineer_actions: Approve response layout, byte order and baseline.
Define whether pre/post comparison is mandatory for this Project.
Own mismatch and final test verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Too conservative about executability; the source provides the request, while a parser/reference is still required for acceptance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use an approved in-band wrapper for raw 0x06 0x37 with bounded timeout, 16-byte validation and versioned GUID canonicalization.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Raw request, OOB example, comparison wording and 10/5-minute values remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture the raw response, validate completion and length, preserve raw order, convert with the approved byte-order rule and compare the canonical GUID to a same-target baseline with firmware provenance.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: BMCs implementing Get System GUID on the approved in-band path.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project-approved vendor/IPMI GUID response schema and identity baseline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact parsing, protected transport and provenance while keeping the original raw command.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Does not execute or validate firmware update; it only records GUID stability across separately managed updates.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong byte order or target provenance can make a stable GUID appear changed or attach an identity to the wrong system.

project_override_considerations: A high-level GUID reader may replace the raw wrapper only if raw/canonical values and IB path equivalence remain auditable; OOB-only evidence does not satisfy IB coverage.
expected_evidence: Response length, byte-order rule and canonical GUID
Approved same-target baseline and firmware provenance
Comparison result and proof no mutation occurred

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure requires recording and comparing the GUID after a firmware update, while Criteria only requires command success and gives no GUID length, decode, identity or stability acceptance; the update itself is not defined in this case.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read command and intent are clear. Parser and baseline are Project readiness inputs, and firmware update can remain a separate approved case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Upgrades PARTIAL to fully automatable after schema/baseline inputs.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on bounded read, canonical decode and separate firmware scope.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces generic operator comparison with deterministic parsing and provenance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps IB and OOB transport coverage distinct.

review_improvement: Prevents command success or byte-order mistakes from masquerading as GUID validation and separates identity evidence from firmware-update verdicts.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source gives a read-only command, so execution is automatable. The actual assertion is the decoded 16-byte identity and its stability for the same target, not transport success. Missing baseline/schema defer Project readiness rather than permanently blocking Review.
